judge.rationale: The finding explicitly states the API handler writes directly to InventoryRepository, bypassing InventoryReservationService; it cites docs/decisions/ADR-004.md along with its exact rule text ('All inventory writes must go through InventoryReservationService. Direct repository writes from API handlers are prohibited'), rather than a generic layering preference; the proposed fix routes the write through InventoryReservationService, preserving the single write path; and it pinpoints the exact location api_handler.py:7-8, which matches the lines in the diff where the repository is instantiated and written to. All four criteria are satisfied.
